intro-01.text: Moving tokens across chains usually means trusting a black box.

intro-02.text: You sign, you wait, and you hope it lands.

intro-03.text: RelayMesh opens the box, right on Portal Dot.

intro-04.text: Choose where it goes, and see each fee before you pay. Then sign once.

intro-05.text: Watch each step settle live, block by block, until the funds arrive on the other side.

intro-06.text: You get a receipt, and its hash is anchored on chain. Anyone can check it, right in their browser.

intro-07.text: It also checks the bridge to B N B Chain, payout by payout, and anchors the result.

intro-08.text: And developers get all of it through an open API, ready to call.

intro-09.text: RelayMesh. Cross-chain transfers you can prove.
